svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Search across many airport, city and country pairs and date ranges in a single search rath
er than one pair at a time (for example, about 11,760 combinations of airports, dates and
cabin classes). → Complete flight research much faster, with substantially less time and m
ental effort per search.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Get all the information needed for a booking in one place instead of visiting 10 to 12 dif
ferent sites. → Complete flight research much faster, with substantially less time and men
tal effort per search.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Compare different booking websites for the chosen itinerary to find the provider that offe
rs the best price and overall deal. → Find a good deal on the flight - primarily a low pri
ce, with seating and other benefits taken into account.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Receive price-drop alerts for several candidate routes so I can book as soon as one of the
m falls within reach. → Find a good deal on the flight - primarily a low price, with seati
ng and other benefits taken into account.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Show whether a fare is above or below the typical price for that market, especially where
I am unfamiliar with local prices. → Find a good deal on the flight - primarily a low pric
e, with seating and other benefits taken into account.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Keep at least 1.5 times (preferably 2 times) the minimum connection time at any stopover.
→ Find a flight itinerary whose timing fits my travel plans - matching onward transport an
d the schedules of people I am meeting, and ideally letting me sleep at night.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Avoid itineraries with long idle waits or excessive total travel time. → Find a flight iti
nerary whose timing fits my travel plans - matching onward transport and the schedules of
people I am meeting, and ideally letting me sleep at night.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
See detailed connection and timing information - layovers, local times, arrival day and to
tal duration - so I can judge whether an itinerary works. → Find a flight itinerary whose
timing fits my travel plans - matching onward transport and the schedules of people I am m
eeting, and ideally letting me sleep at night.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Stay anonymous while searching flights - not logging in and blocking cookies - so that I a
m not tracked or quoted higher prices. → Find a good deal on the flight - primarily a low
price, with seating and other benefits taken into account.
